question:
What is the average of the up votes and the average user age for users creating more than 10 posts?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: creating more than 10 post refers to Count (UserId) > 10; average of the up votes = Divide (Sum(UpVotes), Count (UserId)); average age = Divide (Sum(Age), Count(UserId))

prediction.sql:
SELECT
  (SELECT SUM(u.XCL_061) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT u.XCL_052)
   FROM users u
   WHERE u.XCL_052 IN (
     SELECT p.XCL_033
     FROM posts p
     GROUP BY p.XCL_033
     HAVING COUNT(p.XCL_026) > 10
   )) AS avg_up_votes,
  (SELECT SUM(u.XCL_064) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT u.XCL_052)
   FROM users u
   WHERE u.XCL_052 IN (
     SELECT p.XCL_033
     FROM posts p
     GROUP BY p.XCL_033
     HAVING COUNT(p.XCL_026) > 10
   )) AS avg_user_age

  (SELECT SUM(u.XCL_061) FROM users u JOIN posts p ON p.XCL_033 = u.XCL_052
   WHERE u.XCL_052 IN (SELECT XCL_033 FROM posts GROUP BY XCL_033 HAVING COUNT(*) > 10)) * 1.0 /
